time_override.method: Published fractional-day trail-end times rounded back to the documented nearest minute; midpoint is arithmetic mean. Not inferred by minimizing residuals.
time_override.status: document-supported replication override; independent plate-log review pending
time_override.conflict: IRSA DATE-OBS says January 25 with times 10:05 red and 10:50 blue. STScI red header says January 25 09:65. MPC reports January 26 09:39-10:24 and 10:30-10:42.
time_override.sigma_policy: Conservative 30 seconds 1-sigma floor; not a measured clock calibration. Pre-1962 Horizons UT is UT1, not modern UTC.

sampling_limits: Two exposures of one asteroid, four published endpoints; not four independent exposures. Small demonstration, not a population-level false-positive estimate.
